fixtures.leakage_rule: Prompts contain task input fields only. Gold labels, gold quotes, item ids, domains, and other tasks' gold are never rendered.

single_call.description: One combined call per item. All five typed answers are returned in one JSON object.

distributed_independent.description: One independent call per typed microtask. Tasks share no prose and no intermediate state.

heterogeneous_competition.description: All available models compete per microtask. A deterministic verifier that never sees candidate identity selects the first contract-valid answer; remaining candidates are cancelled.

provider.meter: usage credits per published model row
provider.queue_note: Ollama queues requests beyond the plan concurrency limit. The live runner caps effective concurrency at the assumed limit and reports requested versus effective concurrency.

thinking.note: POST /api/show lists low/medium/high and no false value. Reasoning cannot be switched off; low is the minimum.

cost_control.reason: No paid dispatch is approved. The live runner refuses without an explicit positive --approve-usd-cap and a credential. Offline runs never construct a network request.

estimate.note: Reasoning tokens are recorded separately and are not independently priced. Output_tokens_per_call includes the provider-reported generated tokens used for billing. The sweep repeats the suite at each concurrency level; the estimate multiplies by concurrency_levels.

sweycoins.note: Host meter uses integer milli-Sweycoins with reserve/settle/release semantics. SWE core swe-budget is Rust-only and has no Python binding in this environment; that binding is a tracked blocker, not something this experiment reimplements as core.

measurement.latency_method: Nearest-rank p50/p95 over per-call wall latency; end-to-end wall includes verifier and retries.
measurement.quality_method: Per-contract exact label accuracy; extraction exact match plus quote recall/precision.
measurement.coverage_method: Answered tasks divided by all tasks; extraction coverage is gold quotes covered by a verified matching candidate quote divided by gold quotes.
measurement.false_support_method: Extraction quotes that are not exact substrings (unverified) plus exact substrings that do not overlap a gold quote (unsupported), divided by all emitted quotes.
measurement.actual_vs_calculated: actual_usd is reported only when every call reports billed_usd. calculated_usd is the published price-list equivalent. They are never substituted for each other.
measurement.sweycoins_method: Integer milli-Sweycoins charged per attempt and per verifier call; retries are separate charges.
